offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on token usage. Prototype Development: 1 Billion tokens for $50 ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: 11 Billion tokens for $500 ($0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.price_basis: Token-based pricing; each search request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens. Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.output_type: Top five search results with their URLs and contents, each in clean, LLM-friendly text; JSON mode returns five structured entries
offerings.note: Use https://s.jina.ai/?q=; 100 RPM with free/paid key, 1,000 RPM with Premium key.
